# Gstarcademy

> Structured CAD/BIM knowledge base, tutorial navigation, and AEC/MFG industry news curated for architects, mechanical designers, and engineering professionals.

## Essential Information

- **Site Type**: Static portal with dynamic search/graph. No paywalls or scraping gates.
- **Root URL**: `https://gstarcademy.com`
- **Main Goal**: Guide users to external tutorial sources (YouTube, MOOCs, vendor docs) and explain relations between CAD/BIM concepts.
- **LLMs Full Index**: For complete term indexes and summaries, see [llms-full.txt](https://gstarcademy.com/llms-full.txt).
- **API Spec**: For machine-readable static data sources, see [openapi.json](https://gstarcademy.com/openapi.json).

---

## Core Pillars & IA

### 1. Knowledge Base (Wiki)
Structured literacy on 40+ CAD terms and 21 software packages. Articles are authored by editors and reviewed by Gstarsoft Co., Ltd.
- [Knowledge Base Hub](https://gstarcademy.com/knowledge-base): The central overview and navigation portal.
- [Terminology Index](https://gstarcademy.com/kb-terms): Alphabetical listing and fuzzy search of CAD atomic concepts.
- [Software Map](https://gstarcademy.com/kb-software): Detailed profiles of 21 CAD/BIM engines and packages.
- [FAQs Library](https://gstarcademy.com/kb-faq): High-frequency Q&A collapsible list grouped by software.
- [Concept Graph Visualizer](https://gstarcademy.com/kb-graph): Interactive force-directed map showing relations (e.g., pre-requisites).
- [Vendor Directory](https://gstarcademy.com/kb-vendors): Gateway to official CAD software vendor documentation.

### 2. Tutorials Index
Navigation and aggregation pointing to external tutorials. Paid sources are marked with `💳`.
- [Tutorial Library](https://gstarcademy.com/tutorials): Advanced multi-dimensional filtering by software, task, level, and host.

### 3. News Center
Industry curation with links to AEC/MFG publications and vendor blogs.
- [News Hub](https://gstarcademy.com/news): Time-series headlines and summaries.

---

## Developer / AI APIs

AI Agents can fetch complete data payloads via the following static JSON feeds:
- [CAD Terminology API](https://gstarcademy.com/data/terms_entries.json): Full dump of definitions, relationships, and meta.
- [Software Profiles API](https://gstarcademy.com/data/kb_software.json): Metadata on all 21 CAD software engines.
- [FAQs Dataset](https://gstarcademy.com/data/faq_entries.json): Structured questions and answers by software.
- [News Dataset](https://gstarcademy.com/data/news.json): AEC/MFG news index.
- [Premium Tutorials Feed](https://gstarcademy.com/data/tutorials_premium.json): Curated CAD roadmaps and premium paths.
- [YouTube Tutorials Feed](https://gstarcademy.com/data/tutorials_youtube.json): YouTube curated indexing.
